```{r}
#| label: load-packages-data

#install.packages("haven")
library(shinydashboard)
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggthemes)
library(forcats)

school_safety <- read_sas("data/pu_ssocs18.sas7bdat")

```

```{r}
#| label: filter-data

# filter the data
school_safety <- school_safety |>
  select(
    SCHID, # Unique school identifier
    INCID18, # Number of total incidents
    INCPOL18,# Number of total incident reported to the police
    C0183, # Social emotional learning
    C0181, # Individual mentoring/tutoring/coaching by adults
    C0179, # Student involvement in restorative circles
    C0186, # Promote sense of community/social integration
    C0602, # Threat assessment team formal meetings
    C0669, # Treatment at school by school-employed or contracted mental health professional
    C0271, # Teacher training - intervention and referral strategies
    C0604, # LGBTQ acceptance group
    C0606, # Disability acceptance group
    C0608 # Cultural diversity acceptance group 
  )
    # this code chunk just might be helpful later on
    #contains("pred"), genre, percentile, runtime, gross)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox

  subtitle = "Subtitle",
  color = "red"
)
incidents_record <- school_safety |>
  summarize(incidents_record_sum = sum(INCID18)) 

list(
  icon = "home",
  color = "danger",
  value = incidents_record
)

```


```{r}

  value = incidents_record
)

```
